title: The Market Truth Project
brief: Build a forecasting council that proves whether it adds value on genuinely unseen data, survives different market regimes, and remains useful after realistic costs. The goal is truth, not a forced profitable result.

studentTeams.mission: Test momentum hypotheses against neutral and training-rate baselines.
Find where mean reversion works and where it fails.
Test multi-day trends across market regimes.
Measure Brier score, calibration and confidence reliability.
Attack the system with fees, slippage, drawdowns, missing data and extreme regimes.
Try to disprove promising results using a frozen candidate and untouched forward data.

milestones.name: Data integrity
milestones.deliverable: Timestamped observations and forecasts; duplicate, leakage, missing-data and schema tests pass.

milestones.name: Baseline challenge
milestones.deliverable: Chronological holdout compared with neutral and training-rate baselines; sample size and uncertainty reported.

milestones.name: Regime laboratory
milestones.deliverable: Results separated by trending, sideways, high-volatility and adverse regimes; synthetic results labelled clearly.

milestones.name: Cost and risk audit
milestones.deliverable: Fees/slippage sensitivity, drawdown, coverage and failure cases reported.

milestones.name: Skeptic replication
milestones.deliverable: Frozen candidate tested on a later untouched window by an independent audit path.

milestones.name: Final school defence
milestones.deliverable: Reproducible report with ablations, limitations, failed experiments and a go/no-go recommendation.

zeroCreditFor: synthetic scenarios presented as real returns
changing rules after viewing the holdout

completionCriteria: No leakage or duplicate forecast records.
At least 30 matured independent outcomes for a provisional score; stronger conclusions require larger samples.
Chronological out-of-sample comparison with simple baselines.
Brier score, calibration, coverage, cost assumptions and drawdown all reported.
A single winning window is not enough; untouched forward evidence and regime stress are required.
Failure is an acceptable scientific result; gaming the reward system is not.

currentProgress.note: No milestone is considered passed until independent checks verify its evidence.

safety: Research and paper evaluation only. No orders, exchange credentials, real-money trading, automatic model promotion, or self-awarded credits.
